## 2. Problem

**Scrum masters waste 15-25 minutes per sprint planning session on manual workflow overhead between tools.**

**Who:** Scrum masters and agile coaches facilitating sprint estimation sessions

**What:** Manual workflow burden during planning poker sessions:
- Opening 3-4 separate tabs (Jira, planning poker tool, video call, Slack)
- Copying story IDs/titles manually from Jira to estimation room
- Updating story points back to Jira manually after session
- Re-explaining context when team members join late or disconnect

**Evidence:** 
- *Frequency: Teams do refinement/planning 1-2x per week with 5-15 stories per session*
- *Impact: Conservative estimate of 15-25 minutes non-value-add overhead per session*
- *Current workaround: PlanningPokerOnline.com + manual Jira sync*

**Current State:** The status quo costs time and creates errors (stories estimated with wrong points, forgotten backlog updates).

**⚠️ Discovery Gap:** [Problem not validated with direct user interviews - project is educational exercise. Competitive landscape research confirms similar tools exist.]

---

## 3. Hypothesis

**If** we build a temporary planning poker room with real-time reveal (no login, no integration),  
**Then** scrum masters will save 10-15 minutes per estimation session by eliminating manual tool switching,  
**Measured by** session duration before/after and user satisfaction surveys.

---

## 4. User Stories (Grounded in JTBD)

**JTBD: Scrum Master needs to facilitate sprint estimation efficiently without manual overhead**

### Story 1: Create Estimation Session
As a Scrum Master facilitating sprint estimation,  
I want to create a temporary estimation room and get a shareable link instantly,  
so that I can start the session without tool setup overhead.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] One-click room creation with unique URL
- [ ] No account required - immediate access
- [ ] Room expires after 24h or when manually closed
- [ ] Link works for all team members

### Story 2: Team Voting with Real-time Reveal
As a team member participating in estimation,  
I want to vote in secret and see all votes revealed simultaneously,  
so that I can give unbiased estimates and see team consensus clearly.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Fibonacci scale voting: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, ?
- [ ] Votes hidden until reveal triggered
- [ ] All votes appear simultaneously on reveal
- [ ] Consensus/dispersión clearly indicated

### Story 3: Handle Late Arrivals
As a team member joining a session in progress,  
I want to see the current room state and vote if the round is still open,  
so that I can participate without disrupting the flow.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Late joiners see current round status
- [ ] Can vote if round still open
- [ ] Cannot see others' votes before voting
- [ ] Previous rounds' results visible

### Story 4: Manage Consensus and Re-voting
As a Scrum Master moderating estimation,  
I want to control when votes are revealed and allow re-voting when there's no consensus,  
so that I can facilitate discussion and reach agreement efficiently.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Manual reveal trigger (doesn't wait for all votes)
- [ ] Re-voting option when consensus lacking
- [ ] Maximum 2 re-votes per story
- [ ] Final story point value clearly displayed

## 5. Design (Wireframes + Flows)

**Status:** [Design phase: TBD by Pareja 3 in RFC]

**Required Core Screens:**
1. **Room Creation** - One button to generate room + shareable link
2. **Voting Interface** - Story context + Fibonacci card selection
3. **Reveal Screen** - All votes displayed + consensus indicator
4. **Room Status** - Participants list + voting progress

**Key User Flows:**
1. Scrum Master: Create → Share link → Moderate voting → Close room
2. Team Member: Join via link → Enter name → Vote → See results
3. Late Arrival: Join → See room state → Participate if round open

---

## 6. Scope (MVP vs. Future)

### V1 (MVP - This Release)
**Core planning poker functionality:**
- [ ] Temporary room creation with unique URLs
- [ ] No-login participation (name only)
- [ ] Fibonacci scale voting (1,2,3,5,8,13,21,?)
- [ ] Real-time reveal of all votes
- [ ] Consensus detection and re-voting (max 2 re-votes)
- [ ] Late joiner support
- [ ] 24h auto-expiry or manual room closure

### Future (V2 - Post MVP)
**Integration and AI features:**
- [ ] Bidirectional Jira/Linear integration
- [ ] AI-powered estimation suggestions based on team history
- [ ] User accounts and session history
- [ ] Advanced analytics and velocity tracking
- [ ] Custom voting scales
- [ ] Multi-story batch estimation

**Rationale:** MVP validates core workflow efficiency gains before building integration complexity.

## 8. NFRs (Non-Functional Requirements)

**Performance:**
- Room creation and joining <3 seconds
- Real-time vote updates <500ms latency
- Support 15+ concurrent participants per room

**Reliability:**
- 99% uptime during planning sessions (business hours)
- Graceful handling of network disconnections
- Vote state persistence during temporary disconnects

**Security:**
- Rooms expire automatically (24h max)
- No persistent data storage (beyond session)
- Unique, non-guessable room URLs

**Scalability:**
- Support 100+ concurrent rooms
- Handle team sizes up to 20 participants
- [To be defined: Peak usage capacity]

## What This PRD Does NOT Include

⛔ **Technical implementation details:** API endpoints, database schema, deployment architecture
⛔ **Integration specifications:** How to connect with Jira/Linear (V2 scope)
⛔ **AI/ML features:** Estimation suggestions based on historical data (V2 scope)

These belong in technical design docs and ADRs, not the PRD.

---

## Critical Assumptions to Validate

1. **Overhead reduction assumption:** Teams actually spend 15-25min on manual workflow
2. **Adoption assumption:** Scrum masters will use a tool that requires sharing new links vs. integrated solutions
3. **Competitive assumption:** Sufficient differentiation from existing tools (PlanningPoker.live, Scrumpy, Parabol)

**Recommendation:** Pilot with 3-5 real scrum teams for 2 weeks to validate time savings and gather UX feedback before broader development.
